title: Ghent, public health related ordinances 14th century - dataset
descriptions: This dataset contains a selection of ordinances issued during the 14th century by Ghent's city government. Selected ordinances deal with public health issues: circulation, public sanitation, trade and market regulations, zoning of crafts, immoral behaviours, animals, water management and fire safety.
